interpretation_rules: Static template means serialized or resource-definition data.
Resolved runtime entity means a live object with identity, transform, gameplay state, and/or graphics association.
Progression state means mode-level or durable state such as evolution points, learned abilities, unlocked parts, missions, or cell-stage counters.
A confirmed Ghidra offset does not by itself verify a field's semantic name.
A current fixture is evidence of OpenSpore behavior unless explicitly marked original.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::CreateCellObject
functions.contract: Allocates from the 4096-cell pool, derives cell size from scale/resource/explicit size, fills transform/target/opacity/elevation fields, resolves model/resource/GFX/query/effect state, inserts query state, and returns a pool index.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::GetDamageAmount
functions.contract: Returns 0..6 damage from player/non-player attacker-victim scale relationships; non-player versus non-player uses a 5x5 matrix.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::cCellDataReference_::Create
functions.contract: Looks up or creates a 16-byte cCellDataReference_ keyed by instance ID and CellSerializer, returning an intrusive resource reference.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::cCellGame::Initialize
functions.contract: Resets flags, creates foreground/background query pools, allocates the 4096-cell pool, initializes time scale and serializable state, selects world references, and writes background bounds.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::GetCurrentAdvectInfo
functions.contract: Returns the exact player-size advect row or the -1 default row, including scale, strength, variance, period, and advect ID.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::GetNextAdvectID
functions.contract: Maps current scale to a bucket, searches cAdvectEntry rows for the next bucket, and falls back to the -1 default row or zero.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::GetGlobalsData
functions.contract: Loads a CellGame/ globals resource and returns a cCellGlobalsResource through the Cell resource subsystem.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::GetModelKeyForCellResource
functions.contract: Resolves a cell resource reference and chooses a model key using composition/type branches and a default model key.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::GetScaleDifferenceWithPlayer
functions.contract: Maps another cell's stage scale and the player's scale to a five-value ScaleDifference.

functions.name: App::cCellModeStrategy::Dispose
functions.contract: Restores globals, disables cell display/services, releases cCellGame, cCellGFX, and cCellUI, and performs pause/unpause side effects.

functions.name: App::cCellModeStrategy::OnEnter
functions.contract: Resets mode/UI flags, starts the cell display, and activates cell world/UI/application services.

functions.name: App::cCellModeStrategy::OnExit
functions.contract: Restores background clear globals, drains/cleans cell state, disables the mode, and releases world/effect state.

functions.name: App::cCellModeStrategy::Initialize
functions.contract: Allocates or assigns sCellGame, sCellGFX, and sCellUI, resets mode flags, and performs application pre-shutdown/setup work.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::MovePlayerToMousePosition
functions.contract: Resolves the avatar through mAvatarCellIndex, applies lock/camera/UI gates, intersects a camera ray with the movement plane, writes target position/orientation, and sets the moving flag.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::PlayAnimation
functions.contract: Computes blend-in/out times, scales them by the cell animation-time factor, dispatches the target animation, and stores current/previous animation state.

functions.name: FUN_00e780a0
functions.contract: Clears a matching avatar index, releases query/GFX/effect associations, deallocates the old pool object, and recreates it when stage scale changes.

provenance: Ghidra MCP read-only decompile_function and get_function_callees(0x00E780A0)

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::ShouldNotAttack
functions.contract: Returns an attack exclusion for identical resources, player-target resource flags, small-player restrictions, and equal non-zero territory values.

functions.name: Simulator::Cell::cCellUI::ShowHealthRollover

persistence.boundary: Reference object is runtime/asset identity; its serializer and resource pointer are not gameplay progression.
Base resource object carries bytes and serializer metadata; cCellCellResource and other Cell resources are payload templates.
cCellGame.mpSerializableData is the explicit Cell persistence/progression holder. Read/write function addresses and file format are unresolved.
The global progression object is evidenced, but no disk serialization or ownership relation to cCellSerializableData is established.
Generated fixture state is replay-local and has no demonstrated save/load relation to cCellSerializableData or cCreatureGameData.
Runtime entity fields are observed, but no original persistence path for individual live objects is established.

openspore_comparison.current: Correctly reproduces 28-byte pool metadata, 920-byte element size, 4096 capacity, free-list allocation, exhaustion, and refill tests.
openspore_comparison.boundary: CellPool is a real ABI-oriented projection, but cCellObjectData remains padded and partial; it is not the full logical object schema.
openspore_comparison.incorrect_assumption: Do not treat the padded cCellObjectData as every runtime field or treat pool mIsIdle as the same thing as Entity.alive.

openspore_comparison.current: Struct sizes and cCellQueryEntry fields match the confirmed 16/24/28-byte family; vector arena and LIFO links are a clean-room behavioral projection.
openspore_comparison.boundary: It is not the original linked-pool ABI and the near predicate is a current contract, not a fully traced original query body.
openspore_comparison.incorrect_assumption: Do not treat vector storage, LIFO order, or the radius predicate as original runtime storage/semantics without further body evidence.

openspore_comparison.current: Correctly decodes the 796-byte cCellCellResource, three 180-byte cAIData blocks, 12-byte cEatData, world, populate, structure, loot, look, random-creature, effect-map, background-map, and globals records.
openspore_comparison.boundary: CellResourceSpec deliberately reduces a cell definition to size, model key, and fixed orientation; it is a runtime creation projection, not a full definition schema.
openspore_comparison.incorrect_assumption: Do not use CellResourceSpec as a CreatureData schema or assume current parser output is connected to the original runtime loader.

openspore_comparison.current: No current src/assets implementation or fixture exists for the 296-byte editor resource, 140-byte RigblockData, or capability/animation/effect vectors.
openspore_comparison.boundary: The current CellResource model is separate and cannot stand in for editor creature definitions.
openspore_comparison.incorrect_assumption: Cell records and rigblock records are different schema families; merging them would lose the static-versus-runtime boundary.

openspore_comparison.current: No OpenSpore counterpart models brain level, evolution points, learned abilities, ability mode, avatar normalization, or glide state.
openspore_comparison.boundary: PlayerState.growMeter is a Cell contract field, not a substitute for cCreatureGameData progression.
openspore_comparison.incorrect_assumption: Do not treat growMeter as evolution points, unlocked parts, or persistence.

openspore_comparison.current: No OpenSpore persistence model records playerCreatureKey, food progression, unlocked parts, missions, kill/death counts, or nanites.
openspore_comparison.boundary: Current fixture state is deterministic and replay-local, not a save file.
openspore_comparison.incorrect_assumption: Do not infer original persistence from generated fixtures or from CellSim stateString output.

openspore_comparison.current: The frozen fixture suite deterministically replays movement, eat/flee, advect-like velocity settling, combat-like flee, and world-plane switching.
openspore_comparison.boundary: Speeds, damping, eat/flee radii, event names, and role-based entities are OpenSpore contract choices or inferences; they are not decoded original cCellCellResource semantics.
openspore_comparison.incorrect_assumption: Do not treat fixture food_a/prey_c roles, positions, alive flags, or growMeter as original creature state or persistence.

openspore_comparison.current: Scene assets are loaded from scene.json; cell-family GMDLs and backdrop assets are real records, while all positions and player identity remain provenance-labeled inferred.
openspore_comparison.boundary: The scene is a presentation fixture, not the original procedural world/populate object graph.
openspore_comparison.incorrect_assumption: Do not infer original entity positions from scene.json or treat the player-cell identity as a verified name-to-instance map.

contradictions.counter_evidence: AfterGlideFinish writes float-sized MOVSS values to 0x0169E378, which is sCreatureGameData+0x08.
contradictions.resolution: Keep the SDK field name/type as an export label but mark its runtime type/semantic identity unresolved.

contradictions.claim: CellPool allocation state is equivalent to Entity.alive.
contradictions.counter_evidence: Generic pool allocation sets mIsIdle false, while CreateCellObject writes mIsIdle true; Entity.alive is a separate role-based contract flag.
contradictions.resolution: Treat pool liveness, mIsIdle, and fixture alive as separate state domains.

contradictions.claim: CellQuery vector/LIFO implementation is the original query ABI.
contradictions.counter_evidence: Original structures are linked-pool/data/node records of 16/24/28 bytes; current implementation is a vector arena.
contradictions.resolution: Classify CellQuery as a behavioral projection, not ABI replacement.

contradictions.claim: CellResourceSpec is the complete cell definition.
contradictions.counter_evidence: CellResourceSpec has only size, modelKey, and fixedOrientation; cCellCellResource is 796 bytes with references, HP, AI, eat, unlock/type, loot, and mission fields.
contradictions.resolution: Use CellResourceSpec only as the CreateCellObject input projection.

contradictions.claim: The Cell fixture food_a/prey_c roles and positions are original data.
contradictions.counter_evidence: scene.json and contract scenarios mark positions and roles as inferred/approximated; original population is procedural through world/populate/marker records.
contradictions.resolution: Keep fixture roles/positions as test inputs only.

contradictions.claim: PlayerState.growMeter represents CreatureData progression or persistence.
contradictions.counter_evidence: Original progression has cCreatureGameData evolution/brain/ability fields and cCellSerializableData unlocked-part/food/mission fields; current growMeter is only a contract counter.
contradictions.resolution: Do not use growMeter as a substitute for either progression record.

contradictions.claim: A cCellDataReference_ body at 0x00E82340 is the SDK cCellDataReference_::Create function.
contradictions.counter_evidence: The named SDK function is 0x00E82420; 0x00E82340 remains an adjacent/body candidate in campaign history.
contradictions.resolution: Use 0x00E82420 for the SDK-associated function and retain 0x00E82340 only as an unresolved alias candidate.

contradictions.claim: The advect strength/variance/period record fields are integers.
contradictions.counter_evidence: Ghidra SDK layout says int, while the current byte-decoder and measured records decode these bytes as float32.
contradictions.resolution: Preserve both: SDK declaration and serialized/storage type are not yet reconciled.
